lines.text: Unlocks: Clear event stage 102120112 · After XXX chat 1. Hello, Commander.

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: Hmmm

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: Yan isn't in this room yet, is she?
Neon has invited Yan to join the group.
Welcome to the Working Holiday group chat.

lines.speaker: yan_s
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: yan_s
lines.text: I had no idea a room like this existed.

lines.speaker: yan_s
lines.text: Isn't our mission already over?

lines.speaker: yan_s
lines.text: Why are you inviting me in here?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Because there's definitely gonna be at least

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: one

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: more

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: vacation.
I've already spoken with my superior.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Oh?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: What did they say?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: C'mon, teeelllll mmeeeee!
If any mission comes up, he'll send us.
There won't be any further missions.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: What? How come?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: You mean Andersen said no?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Does he have a personal grudge against me or something?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: What'd I ever do to this guy?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I never did anything!
I was just joking, hehe.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: So does that mean...
We've got approval. We can go back to the island.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Yahoo!

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: I wanna go too!

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: I think it goes without saying that I'd love to tag along as well.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: I never thought another opportunity would come this quickly.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: You're the best, Commander.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: You'll keep your promise,

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: won't you?
Of course.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: You're always full of surprises, hehe.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: I know I keep saying it,

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: but thank you.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: ... What's going on between you two?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: You both seem awfully chummy all of a sudden.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Sorry, it's a secret, hehe!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Bah!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I knew there was a reason I felt uneasy being separated from everyone else.

lines.speaker: yan_s
lines.text: If you insist on talking about this, the three of you can create your own chat group.

lines.speaker: yan_s
lines.text: Anyway, if you're going, take me too.

lines.speaker: yan_s
lines.text: Now that Talentum has partial access to the resource distribution rights,

lines.speaker: yan_s
lines.text: this last excursion is paying off handsomely.

lines.speaker: yan_s
lines.text: What lobbying strategies did you use to

lines.speaker: yan_s
lines.text: get approval so quickly, Rookie?
All I did was mention your performance in my report.

lines.speaker: yan_s
lines.text: No kidding?

lines.speaker: yan_s
lines.text: So that's why they have been putting the focus on grain lately.

lines.speaker: yan_s
lines.text: I've received several new contract offers from the Wildlife Agency.

lines.speaker: yan_s
lines.text: We're gonna be raking in the dough, and it's all thanks to you.
It was a nice give and take.
I also benefitted from this. I got to see you in a swimsuit.

lines.speaker: yan_s
lines.text: I assume you're referring to my swimsuits?

lines.speaker: yan_s
lines.text: I'm glad you enjoyed them. We put a lot of effort into them.

lines.speaker: yan_s
lines.text: Oh, believe me, I know I looked good in it.

lines.speaker: yan_s
lines.text: Talentum spared no expense in crafting the finest swimsuit we could.

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: So,

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: when are we setting out?
Still to be determined at this point.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Er...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Can you at least give us a rough estimate?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: At least give me something to cling to while I wait.
If I had to guess... maybe two months?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Two months?

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: That's sooner than I thought.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Sooner?! Are you kidding? That's like forever away.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: I'll be working at the center, so time will fly by for me.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Will you and I have an opportunity to see each other before we head out?

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: Wait... do you mean for a checkup?

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Yep, hehe.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Gahhh!

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Oh stop, it's not that bad.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: You won't have to wait in line for very long, so it'll all be over fast.
No one replies.
